humble_administrator.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
humble_administrator.price_text: ≈ CNY 70–80 in high season; check on the day
humble_administrator.tip: Go right at opening to beat the tour groups. The garden is small but crowded by mid-morning.

suzhou_museum.name: Suzhou Museum
suzhou_museum.price_text: Free; book a timed slot online in advance
suzhou_museum.tip: Free entry but slots fill fast — reserve a few days ahead on the official site.

tiger_hill.name: Tiger Hill, Suzhou
tiger_hill.tip: Climb to the leaning Yunyan Pagoda early; the hill gets hot and busy by late morning.

tongli.name: Tongli Water Town
tongli.price_text: ≈ CNY 80–100 combined ticket; check on the day
tongli.tip: A full day trip from central Suzhou. Stay into late afternoon after the day crowds thin.
tongli.best: Weekday, early morning to late afternoon

grand_canal_boat.name: Grand Canal Boat
grand_canal_boat.price_text: ≈ CNY 40–100 depending on route; check on the day
grand_canal_boat.tip: Short canal cruises leave near Pingjiang Road and Shantang Street. Confirm the route and price at the dock.

pingjiang_walk.name: Pingjiang Road canal walk
pingjiang_walk.hours: Always open; liveliest from late morning to night
pingjiang_walk.tip: Walk the stone lanes beside the canal early, then come back at dusk for lanterns and snacks.

shantang_street.name: Shantang Street
shantang_street.price_text: Free to walk; small fees for some halls
shantang_street.tip: A canal street with snacks and small temples. Quieter and more local-feeling than Pingjiang at night.

suzhou_noodles.name: Suzhou noodle breakfast (local shops)
suzhou_noodles.tip: Try a bowl of Suzhou-style noodles with braised pork or shrimp. Locals eat this for breakfast.

guanqian_food.name: Guanqian Street food and shopping
guanqian_food.tip: A busy pedestrian street for snacks and souvenirs. Good for an easy evening stroll after the gardens.

jinji_lake.name: Jinji Lake waterfront
jinji_lake.tip: Modern skyline views across the lake. Come at sunset for the best light and photos.

silk_museum.name: Suzhou Silk Museum
silk_museum.tip: Small and free, next to the museum area. Good for understanding Suzhou's silk trade.

master_of_nets.name: Master of the Nets Garden
master_of_nets.tip: Smaller and calmer than the Humble Administrator's Garden. A good pick if the big garden is packed.

panmen_gate.name: Panmen Gate and Ruiguang Pagoda
panmen_gate.tip: Old city gate, pagoda and canal views in one spot. Climb the pagoda for a wide look over the area.

suzhou_opera.name: Kunqu opera or pingtan show
suzhou_opera.price_text: ≈ CNY 50–150 depending on venue; check on the day
suzhou_opera.tip: Short tea-house performances of local opera and story-singing are easy for first-timers. Book a seat in advance.

bike_city.name: Old town bicycle loop
bike_city.price_text: ≈ CNY 10–30 per hour for a shared bike
bike_city.tip: Rent a shared bike and ride the lanes between the gardens and the canal. Stay off main roads at rush hour.

tea_house.name: Canal-side tea house
tea_house.tip: Sit by the window over the canal with a pot of local green tea. Prices vary — ask before ordering.

suzhou_station_area.name: North Temple Pagoda area walk
suzhou_station_area.price_text: Free to walk; small fee for the pagoda
suzhou_station_area.tip: A quieter old-town corner near the station. Good for a short walk if you have time before a train.

lion_grove.name: Lion Grove Garden
lion_grove.tip: Famous for its maze of rockeries. Fun with kids but slippery — watch your step.

suzhou_embroidery.name: Suzhou embroidery workshop visit
suzhou_embroidery.tip: See local double-sided embroidery being made and buy small pieces directly. Ask before taking photos.

huqiu_market.name: Local wet market morning visit
huqiu_market.price_text: Free to browse; bring cash for snacks
huqiu_market.tip: Go early to see fresh produce, dumplings and breakfast stalls. A good cheap breakfast stop.
